references.text: The fat and the breast are mentioned as parts of the peace offering that must be presented before the Lord
The wave breast and the heave arm are given to Aaron and his sons as their portion from the peace offerings
Moses placed all the parts on the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them as a wave offering before the Lord
The fat was laid upon the breast pieces, and the breast pieces were waved as a wave offering before the Lord
The wave breast and the heave arm shall be eaten in a clean place, as part of the peace offerings of the people of Israel
The wave offering is performed at the consecration of the priests, where the breast is waved before the Lord
The priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord in connection with the Nazirite vow
